card.title: Early release
lines: School ends at noon. On the Miami Book Fair trip? Go to your first class as usual. The bus leaves at 8:00 AM. Have your ride at Mater by 2:00 PM.
Period 2 trip students: go to the Media Center at 7:30 like everyone else. Ms. Macho marks you TRIP and sends you to the bus when it is announced. The bus leaves at 8:00 AM.

Not on the trip? Go to the Media Center. Silvina Macho is with you. Your class meets for 47 minutes: P2 Seminar 7:30-8:17, P4 Research 9:25-10:12, P6 Seminar 10:19-11:06, P8 Seminar 11:13-12:00. You work alone, then write a short closing note.

AP Seminar: Open the own-source writing, source log, report plan or feedback you already have. Choose one existing piece to improve. If you have no draft, use an accessible source already in your work to identify its claim, evidence, reasoning and one limitation in your existing document. If you cannot open your work, record the access problem and your next step on paper. Work quietly on your own piece. If you are stuck, record the exact question and continue another part you can advance.

AP Seminar closing: Save your work where it already belongs. Record what you improved and one question for Mr. Portela. If access failed, record that problem and your next step. You do not need a new report, a word-count total or a separate extra slip.

AP Research: Open your portfolio and your latest feedback or last status entry. Work on one part of your proposal you can advance. If you are stuck, record the exact question, then continue another accessible part. Before the bell, update your status and the first step for the next class.

AP Research closing: Save your work. In your portfolio, update your status and write the first step for the next class. If you could not open your work, write the problem, your status and your next step on paper.
AP Research: Sample Paper Reasoning Move is due today in Classroom. Revised Inquiry Proposal and records is due Monday, November 30, 11:59 PM.
AP Research: no surveys, interviews, observations or data from other people today, and do not invite anyone to take part in a study. That work needs a review first.
Nobody has to finish a report, a plan or a section today. Today's class adds no new grade or homework.
Links: on a computer, open Sources at the top, or open your class's Classroom.
lines_es: La escuela termina al mediodía. ¿Vas al viaje a la Feria del Libro de Miami? Ve a tu primera clase como siempre. El autobús sale a las 8:00 AM. Que te recojan en Mater a las 2:00 PM.

sem-1.title: Source reasoning: Retrieve and locate
body: What is the author claiming? What supports it? What does it not establish?

sem-2.title: Source reasoning: Locate the task
body: Paragraph /4: claim, support, inference, limit.
P2/P5/P7: paragraph + decision exit (/4 each).
P6/P8: one source-reasoning score /4.
Decision exit (P2/P5/P7), one point each:
1. Shows the sentence that changed
2. Says what the partner's check found
3. Explains one choice in the revision
4. Checks the changed sentence against the source

sem-3.title: Source reasoning: Read the common passage
body: Goldsmith, "Go Ahead: Waste Time on the Internet" (2016), paragraphs 4 to 7.
Mark claim, example and inference.
Treat the passage as a historical argument, not a current scientific finding.

sem-4.title: Source reasoning: Model the reasoning
body: Observation → inference → scope.

sem-5.title: Source reasoning: Test the inference
body: Which conclusion exceeds the evidence?
A: Some device use includes sustained reading.
B: The passage challenges a blanket claim.
C: Devices improve concentration for all users.

sem-6.title: Source reasoning: Use your own source
body: Check credibility and relevance.
Who produced it? What supports trust?
Why does it fit? What needs checking?
Write: claim, support, explanation, limit.
Keep the source open.

sem-7.title: Source reasoning: Peer check and revise
body: Keep the paragraph before the check.
Point to evidence. Test the explanation and limit.
Identify a specific issue or strength.
Revise a sentence and explain the source-based reason.

sem-8.title: Source reasoning: Exit and next lesson
body: Show the sentence that changed.
Say what the partner's check found.
Explain one choice in the revision.
Check the changed sentence against the source.
P2/P5/P7: exit /4. P6/P8: paragraph /4.

sem-9.title: Practice card: Source reasoning
body: Use current work or the accessible passage.
Paragraph: claim, support, inference, limit.
Keep the paragraph before the peer check.
Show a changed sentence and explain your choice.
Report the partner check; check against the source.
Use your period's scoring criteria on slide 2.

sem-10.title: Comparing sources: Retrieve
body: Open your Workshop 1 paragraph. Highlight the claim. Bold its support. Put one limit in [brackets].
body_es: Abre tu párrafo del Taller 1. Resalta la afirmación. Pon en negrita su apoyo. Pon un límite entre [corchetes].

sem-11.title: Comparing sources: Read Carr
body: Carr, "How Smartphones Hijack Our Minds" (2017), paragraphs 7 to 10.
What was compared? Who participated? What was measured? What does Carr infer?
Carr reports others' research. Separate Carr's account from the original study.
body_es: Carr, "How Smartphones Hijack Our Minds" (2017), párrafos 7 a 10.
¿Qué se comparó? ¿Quiénes participaron? ¿Qué se midió? ¿Qué infiere Carr?
Carr informa sobre la investigación de otras personas. Separa el relato de Carr del estudio original.

sem-12.title: Comparing sources: Comparison model
body: Conditions | outcome | support | scope
body_es: Condiciones | resultado | apoyo | alcance

sem-13.title: Comparing sources: A real connection
body: Agree / qualify / complement / conflict: explain the relation.
body_es: Coinciden / una matiza a la otra / se complementan / se contradicen: explica la relación.

sem-14.title: Comparing sources: Own-source matrix
body: For two sources from your log, write each one's claim, support and one limit. Then name how they relate and what that changes. Write it in your current document under today's date.
body_es: Para dos fuentes de tu registro, escribe la afirmación, el apoyo y un límite de cada una. Luego nombra cómo se relacionan y qué cambia eso. Escríbelo en tu documento actual bajo la fecha de hoy.

sem-15.title: Comparing sources: Write the synthesis
body: Turn your table into one paragraph about the idea, not one per author. Name each author with a verb: reports, argues or infers.
body_es: Convierte tu tabla en un párrafo sobre la idea, no uno por autor. Nombra a cada autor con un verbo: informa, argumenta o infiere.

sem-16.title: Comparing sources: From paragraph to report plan
body: Write two or three report section headings. Name each by an idea, not an author.
body_es: Escribe dos o tres encabezados de sección para el informe. Nombra cada uno por una idea, no por un autor.

sem-17.title: Comparing sources: Exit
body: What did the comparison change? What is your next evidence need?
body_es: ¿Qué cambió la comparación? ¿Qué evidencia necesitas ahora?

sem-18.title: Practice card: Compare sources
body: Connect two already-read sources and explain what the relationship changes. Preserve attribution.
If a second source is unavailable, name the gap and continue source reasoning.
Use your current document. Formative practice.

10:00 AM · Teens Read the National Book Awards. Room 2106. Readings, conversation and your questions for the authors, until 11:30.

bf-books-1.title: The books: our host and the finalists
bf-books-1.title_es: Los libros: la anfitriona y los finalistas
body: Host: Sabaa Tahir, National Book Award winner and author of Empire.
Holloway, by Elana K. Arnold. National Book Award Finalist. Grieving her mom, Nora runs into a French forest at night and wakes up years in the future.

That Which Feeds Us: A Hawaiian Gothic, by Keala Kendall. National Book Award Finalist. A girl searches a luxury resort island with no cell service for her missing twin, and the island's past starts reaching for her.

Shook, by Julian Randall. National Book Award Finalist. A Chicago eighth grader with varsity basketball dreams breaks his ankle in the big game and has to figure out who he is off the court. A novel in verse.
body_es: Anfitriona: Sabaa Tahir, ganadora del National Book Award y autora de Empire.
Holloway, de Elana K. Arnold. Finalista del National Book Award. En duelo por su mamá, Nora corre de noche hacia un bosque francés y despierta años en el futuro.

That Which Feeds Us: A Hawaiian Gothic, de Keala Kendall. Finalista del National Book Award. Una chica busca a su gemelo o gemela desaparecida en una isla de resorts de lujo sin señal de celular, y el pasado de la isla empieza a alcanzarla.

Shook, de Julian Randall. Finalista del National Book Award. Un chico de octavo grado de Chicago que sueña con el equipo varsity de baloncesto se rompe el tobillo en el gran partido y tiene que descubrir quién es fuera de la cancha. Una novela en verso.

bf-books-2.title: The books: the longlist
body: The Free Verse Society, by Delali Adjoa. Longlist. A teen with a past bigger than her classmates know gets stuck planning a poetry reading with the one boy who might see through her.
The Celestial Seas, by T. A. Chan. Longlist. Moby-Dick in outer space: the last survivor of a space whaling crew hunts the living ship that destroyed it.
Life on the Moon, by Matthew Swanson and illustrator Robbi Behr. Longlist. Twelve-year-old Leo's dad vanishes on a Moon-colony mission nobody admits exists, and Leo finds out the Moon isn't empty.
body_es: The Free Verse Society, de Delali Adjoa. Lista larga. Una adolescente con un pasado más grande de lo que saben sus compañeros tiene que organizar una lectura de poesía con el único chico que podría ver quién es de verdad.
The Celestial Seas, de T. A. Chan. Lista larga. Moby-Dick en el espacio: la última persona viva de una tripulación ballenera espacial caza a la nave viviente que la destruyó.

Life on the Moon, de Matthew Swanson, con ilustraciones de Robbi Behr. Lista larga. Leo tiene doce años. Su papá desaparece en una misión a una colonia en la Luna que nadie admite que existe, y Leo descubre que la Luna no está vacía.

Keep your phone charged and on ring. When a chaperone texts or calls, answer right away.
School rules apply all day. You're representing Mater downtown.
Only our group. Friends and family can't meet up with us or join the group at the Fair.
Be a great audience at Teens Read: phones away, questions ready.
Bags get checked by campus Public Safety at the entrance. Weapons of any kind are banned.
Go home only from Mater. Everyone rides the bus back, no early pickups at the Fair.
body_es: Quédate con tu compañero (buddy) todo el día. Nadie anda solo.
Quédate dentro de la Feria. No salgas del área de la Feria por ningún motivo.
Llega a tiempo. El autobús sale a la 1:00 PM, contigo o sin ti. Faltar a un reporte es un asunto de disciplina y te puede costar futuros viajes.
Mantén tu teléfono cargado y con el timbre activado. Cuando un chaperón te escriba o te llame, contesta enseguida.
Las reglas de la escuela aplican todo el día. Representas a Mater en el centro de la ciudad.
Solo nuestro grupo. Amigos y familiares no pueden reunirse con nosotros ni unirse al grupo en la Feria.
Sé un gran público en Teens Read: teléfonos guardados, preguntas listas.
Public Safety del campus revisa las bolsas en la entrada. Se prohíben armas de cualquier tipo.
Vete a casa solo desde Mater. Todos regresan en el autobús; nadie se va antes desde la Feria.

bf-buddies.title: Buddies and check-ins
body: Chaperone numbers: on the bus Friday morning, you'll get a card with your chaperones' cell numbers. Save them in your phone before we arrive.

Buddy pairs: choose one classmate who is also going as your buddy, and reply to the email with their name by Thursday, November 19, at 3:00 PM. No buddy yet? Mr. Portela will pair you up on the bus. You and your buddy stay together all day.
8:00 AM: roll call on the bus.
11:30 AM: headcount outside Room 2106.
12:10 PM: text your chaperone your name, your buddy's name and OK.
12:40 PM: meet at the spot we'll show you after Teens Read.
body_es: Números de los chaperones: el viernes por la mañana, en el autobús, recibirás una tarjeta con los números de celular de tus chaperones. Guárdalos en tu teléfono antes de llegar.

Parejas: elige como compañero (buddy) a alguien de tu clase que también vaya, y responde al correo con su nombre a más tardar el jueves 19 de noviembre a las 3:00 PM. ¿Todavía no tienes pareja? El Sr. Portela te asignará una en el autobús. Tú y tu compañero se quedan juntos todo el día.
8:00 AM: se pasa lista en el autobús.
11:30 AM: conteo afuera del salón 2106.
12:10 PM: envía un mensaje a tu chaperón con tu nombre, el nombre de tu compañero y OK.
12:40 PM: reúnete en el lugar que te mostraremos después de Teens Read.

bf-help.title: If something goes wrong
body: Lost or separated? Stay where you are and call or text a chaperone right away.
Need help on site? Go to the Fair's Information Booth or the Miami Dade College Public Safety Office. Both are on the Fair map in the Fair Guide, marked with an i.
Mater main office: (305) 828-1886. Miami Book Fair office: 305-237-3258.
A real emergency? Call 911 first, then a chaperone.
Never leave the Fair with anyone, and never get in a car there. Everyone rides the bus back to Mater.
body_es: ¿Te perdiste o te separaste? Quédate donde estás y llama o envía un mensaje a un chaperón de inmediato.
¿Necesitas ayuda allí? Ve al Information Booth de la Feria o a la oficina de Public Safety de Miami Dade College. Los dos están en el mapa de la Feria en la Fair Guide, marcados con una i.
Oficina principal de Mater: (305) 828-1886. Oficina de Miami Book Fair: 305-237-3258.
¿Una emergencia real? Llama primero al 911 y luego a un chaperón.
Nunca salgas de la Feria con nadie y nunca te subas a un carro allí. Todos regresan a Mater en el autobús.

bf-lunch.title: Snack, water and lunch
body: The school is packing a snack for each of you: chips, a cereal bar and juice. Water will be provided too, and you're welcome to bring an empty water bottle to refill on campus.
For a real lunch, bring money for the food trucks at Smorgasburg Miami and the Food Court. You'll want something filling after a morning with the authors.
Food allergy or a health need? Write it on your permission form and tell Mr. Portela in Room 63 by Thursday, so we can plan for it.
body_es: La escuela prepara una merienda para cada estudiante: papitas, una barra de cereal y jugo. También habrá agua, y puedes traer una botella de agua vacía para llenarla en el campus.
Para un almuerzo de verdad, trae dinero para los food trucks de Smorgasburg Miami y el Food Court. Vas a querer algo que llene después de una mañana con los autores.
¿Tienes una alergia a alimentos o una necesidad de salud? Escríbela en tu permiso y díselo al Sr. Portela en el salón 63 a más tardar el jueves, para que podamos prepararnos.

claim.def_en: What the author says is true.
claim.def_es: Lo que el autor dice que es cierto.

support.def_en: The evidence or reasons behind a claim.
support.def_es: La evidencia o las razones detrás de una afirmación.

inference.def_en: A conclusion drawn from the evidence.
inference.def_es: Una conclusión que se saca de la evidencia.

limit.def_es: Lo que la evidencia no puede mostrar.

scope.def_en: Who and what a conclusion covers.
scope.def_es: A quién y a qué cubre una conclusión.

credibility.def_es: Razones para confiar en una fuente.

relevance.def_en: How well a source fits your question.
relevance.def_es: Qué tan bien encaja una fuente con tu pregunta.

attribution.def_en: Saying which source an idea comes from.
attribution.def_es: Decir de qué fuente viene una idea.

synthesis.def_en: Connecting sources to explain something new.
synthesis.def_es: Conectar fuentes para explicar algo nuevo.

perspective.def_en: A point of view on an issue.
perspective.def_es: Un punto de vista sobre un tema.

record.def_en: One documented observation or entry in your data.
record.def_es: Una observación o entrada documentada en tus datos.

reference.def_es: El tiempo que describe un registro.

method.def_en: How you will collect and analyze evidence.
method.def_es: Cómo vas a recolectar y analizar la evidencia.

feedback.def_en: Comments on your work that guide revision.
feedback.def_es: Comentarios sobre tu trabajo que guían la revisión.

revision.def_en: A change to your work, with a reason.
revision.def_es: Un cambio en tu trabajo, con una razón.
